passage: Every Saturday morning, I walk to the old market near my home. It opens at seven and closes at twelve. The market is small but full of life. Old Mr. Chen sells fruit at the first stall. His apples are sweet and his prices are low. Next to him, a young woman sells fresh bread. The smell of bread fills the air. In the middle of the market, there is a flower shop. The flowers are bright and beautiful. I always buy some red flowers for my wife. At the back of the market, an old man plays music. He plays the same song every week, and people stop to listen. I usually finish my shopping in one hour. Then I walk home slowly with my heavy bag. It is a simple morning, but it makes me happy.
